name: dshd-pooler
description: Deepartments provider-adapter boot-check helpers for the pooler re-wire: the pure endpoint-drift detector (providerAdapterEndpointDrift + LOCAL_ENDPOINT_RE), the pure boot-findings resolver (resolveProviderAdapterBootFindings), and the dependency-free settings.yaml reader/parser (readLlmPiAiProviderSettings/parseLlmPiAiProviderSettings) — extracted for the dshd-pooler phase of the modular Cordis split. A pure library package (NO cordis plugin, NO tool, NO patch): the bundle consumes it through the drop-in bridge src/core/pooler.ts; the ONLY impure surface is the readFileSync in readLlmPiAiProviderSettings (the stateDir path is passed by parameter).
